taste:
The Large Breakfast is a rich, savoury plate with plenty of crisp texture from the bacon, hash browns and toast. Two fried eggs, two Lincolnshire sausages and two slices of bacon give it a substantial centre, while the three hash browns make crunch a prominent part of the meal. Buttered toast adds another layer of richness rather than making this a restrained breakfast.

The earthy flat mushroom brings a different flavour alongside the salty bacon. Baked beans and half a grilled tomato round out the familiar cooked breakfast combination. With several components to alternate between, this suits someone who wants variety as well as quantity on the same plate.
